title: 第13章 杀人夺血改第14章 阴死极阴的办法改
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
日头西落，残阳如血。
宋文有些心灰意冷的走在街上。
走着走着，突然两名花枝招展、衣衫轻薄的少妇拦住了他的去路。
“大爷，进来玩一玩啊。”
两名少妇一左一右挽住了宋文的手臂，欲露还羞的酥胸在宋文手臂上蹭啊蹭。
蹭得宋文邪火大盛，他抬眼一看，一座三层高的楼宇出现在眼前，楼上阳台还有十几名衣着清凉的少妇，正对着过往的行人搔首弄姿，引得路人纷纷侧目观望。
宋文意识到，自己不知不觉间来到了勾栏。
他顿时有些意动，他觉得自己烦闷的心情，需要找个地方发泄，眼前的勾栏正好合适。
就在他准备顺势跟着两女进入勾栏，体验一下古时勾栏风情时，突然他感觉腰间一阵酸痛。
他猛然惊醒，自己现在虚得厉害，即使进了勾栏，恐怕无能为力，只能望*兴叹啊。
宋文猛然发力，挣脱了两女的束缚，口中还忙不迭的解释道。
“下次，下次。”
看着宋文落荒而逃的背影，一女不屑的冷哼道。
“哼，中看不中用，年纪轻轻就虚得不行，白瞎了一副好看的皮囊。”
离开勾栏，宋文注意到西落的太阳，他意识到自己该回去了。
既然城中医馆解不了毒，那就只能返回天煞帮，可能还有一线生机。
他担忧在天黑之后，盐城的黑恶势力会露头，他还在城市中闲逛，可能会遇到危险。
而此时他身处盐城的北城，天煞帮在盐城的南城，他要回去，意味着他要穿越整个盐城。
自从成功引气入体之后，宋文的思维能力得到了大幅提升，他在脑海之中默默思索了整个盐城大概的布局，以及今日所走路线，脑海之中很快便浮现出最短的返程线路。
白天的时候，宋文走的都是主道，现在为了尽快返回天煞帮，难免会穿越一些小巷子。

当天色暗下来，视物已变得影影绰绰的时候，宋文已经接近天煞帮驻地了，他只要穿过眼前的小巷子，然后进入前方主道之上，很快就能到天煞帮。
眼前的巷子人迹罕至，巷子一旁的臭水沟不时发出阵阵恶臭。
行至一半之时，宋文突然看见前方出现一高一矮两道身影。
“想来是父子俩吧！”
光线太差，看不清两道身影的面貌，宋文也没多想，继续前行。
他在吞服了血气丹之后，修为已经进阶到了第一层后期，虽然他从未修行过任何的招式和法术，无法发挥出真正实力，但仅凭体内灵力，寻常之人也远不是他对手。
当双方相距三丈之时，宋文逐渐看清楚了两人大致样貌，是一名壮汉带着一个十岁左右孩童。
那壮汉的肌肉极为发达，把身上的袍子都撑得鼓鼓胀胀。
“难道是传言中修行外家硬功夫的武者？”
来了此方世界两个多月，宋文对此方世界的武力情况有了初步了解。
他曾见过，天煞帮的外练高手，能轻易举起数百斤巨石，一拳轰将石块轰得四分五裂。
而另一个矮小的孩童，令宋文心中警惕大作。
这孩童赫然正是当初，和宋文争抢馒头、被宋文踢伤的小乞丐。
此时，对面的小乞丐也认出了宋文，他突然拉着壮汉，声音中充满仇恨的说道。
“彪哥，上次就是这小子打伤的我，让我足足卧床休息了一个多月。”
彪哥瞬间暴怒，他手下一共控制着十二名小乞丐，他平日里的生活花销，全靠这些小乞丐乞讨而来。
content_en:
The sun sets in the west, and the setting sun is like blood.
Song Wen walked down the street a little discouraged.
As he was walking, two young women in gorgeous clothes and thin clothes suddenly blocked his way.
"Uncle, come in and play."
The two young women held Song Wen's arms, one on the left and the other on the right, and their breasts were rubbed against Song Wen's arms.
Song Wenxie was so angry that he looked up and saw a three-story building in front of him. There were more than a dozen young women in cool clothes on the balcony upstairs, posing and posing at the passers-by, attracting passers-by to look sideways.
Song Wen realized that he had arrived at Goulan without knowing it.
He suddenly felt moved. He felt that he needed to find a place to vent his depressed mood, and the hook bar in front of him was just right.
Just when he was about to follow the two women into Goulan and experience the ancient Goulan style, he suddenly felt a soreness in his waist.
He suddenly woke up. He was so weak now that even if he got into the hook, he would be unable to do anything but hope and sigh.
Song Wen suddenly exerted his strength, broke free from the restraints of the two women, and explained hurriedly.
"Next time, next time."
Looking at Song Wen's fleeing figure, a woman snorted disdainfully.
"Hmph, it's useless to look at it. You're so weak at a young age, and you've lost all your good-looking skin."
After leaving Goulan, Song Wen noticed the setting sun and realized that it was time to go back.
Since the city's traditional Chinese medicine clinic can't cure the poison, they can only return to the Tiansha Gang, and there may be a glimmer of hope.
He was worried that the evil forces in Yancheng would show up after dark, and he might be in danger if he wandered around the city.
At this time, he was in the north city of Yancheng, and the Tiansha Gang was in the south city of Yancheng. He wanted to go back, which meant that he had to travel through the entire Yancheng.
Since successfully introducing Qi into his body, Song Wen's thinking ability has been greatly improved. He silently thought about the general layout of Yancheng and the route he took today, and the shortest return route soon appeared in his mind.
During the day, Song Wen took the main road. Now in order to return to the Tiansha Gang as soon as possible, he would inevitably pass through some small alleys.
When the sky darkened and things became blurry, Song Wen was already close to the Tiansha Gang's headquarters. He only had to walk through the small alley in front of him and enter the main road ahead, and he would soon reach the Tiansha Gang.
The alley in front of me is deserted, and the stinking ditch beside the alley emits a foul stench from time to time.
Halfway through the journey, Song Wen suddenly saw two figures, one tall and one short, appearing in front of him.
"I guess it's father and son!"
The light was too poor to see clearly the faces of the two figures, so Song Wen didn't think much and continued moving forward.
After swallowing the Blood Qi Pill, his cultivation has advanced to the late first level. Although he has never practiced any moves or spells and cannot display his true strength, ordinary people are far from his match with the spiritual power in his body.
When the two sides were three feet apart, Song Wen gradually saw their general appearance clearly. They were a strong man and a child of about ten years old.
The strong man's muscles were extremely developed, making the robe on his body bulge.
"Is he the rumored warrior who practices foreign martial arts?"
After coming to this world for more than two months, Song Wen had a preliminary understanding of the military situation in this world.
He had seen that the masters of the Tiansha Clan could easily lift hundreds of kilograms of boulders and smash them into pieces with one punch.
But there was another short child who made Song Wen wary.
This child was clearly the little beggar who was kicked and injured by Song Wen when he fought with Song Wen for the steamed buns.
At this time, the little beggar opposite also recognized Song Wen. He suddenly pulled the strong man and said with hatred in his voice.
"Brother Biao, it was this kid who injured me last time and made me stay in bed for more than a month."
Brother Biao was instantly furious. He controlled a total of twelve little beggars. His daily living expenses depended entirely on this.Some little beggars came begging.
